system.summary: unknown: neither file has been seen. The Münster chancery of 1658-59 used numeric alphabets with syllabaries, symbol alphabets, homophonic numeric keys and numbered code lists (W 005 Nr. 499 a); which system Körler used in 1674-75 is unknown.
system.notes: symbol_kind and key_order are placeholders: the schema has no 'unknown' value for them. 'separate passages' is the finding aid's 'zum Teil chiffriert', unseen. Input: Münster key volumes W 005 Nr. 499 a (1659) and Nr. 475 (1689), images from the DDB binaries API; not matched to any ciphertext.

prior_solution.where: Contemporary decipherments on the documents, per the archive's reply (Landesarchiv NRW Abt. Westfalen, ref. W2-2026-18182, 27 Nov 2026, reported by Brice Dudout in issue #1026), not seen here: Nr. 673 fol. 298r has the plaintext in the left margin; Nr. 3009's short cipher passages are mostly deciphered above the lines. Hüttenheim 1974 (Die Geheimschriften des Fürstbistums Münster unter Christoph Bernhard von Galen 1650-1678) still not seen. Neither decipherment has been seen or used here.

conditions.human_role: Pasted the catalogue task; no other input.
tools: DDB Solr index and binaries API

solution.what: DDB index and binaries API on B 001 Nr. 3009 and Nr. 673: no digital objects. Sibling B 001 Nr. 7801 (Körler alias Dorotheus Diethrichs, Vienna reports 1674) found by DDB search; not digitised either.

Downloaded and inventoried the digitised key volumes W 005 Nr. 499 a (41 images; keys of ca. 1658-59 incl. a Galen-Volmar-Montecuccoli key and a code list to 672) and Nr. 475 (67 images; a chancellor's key of 24 Feb. 1689). No key dated 1634-35 or 1674-75; nothing can be tested without the ciphertext.
Web search on Körler, Galen and Münster ciphers: found Hüttenheim 1974, the monograph on Galen's ciphers 1650-1678; not online, not seen. No other edition or decipherment.

Brice Dudout asked LAV NRW Abt. Westfalen about B 001 Nr. 673 and Nr. 3009 (issue #1026). The archive replied (ref. W2-2026-18182) after looking at the originals: Nr. 673 fol. 298r carries the plaintext of its cipher passage in the left margin; Nr. 3009's short cipher passages are mostly deciphered above the lines at the time. Reproductions declined, no copies ordered. Recorded from the issue's summary; neither the email nor the documents seen here. Sibling Nr. 7801 not covered.

gaps.item: A, B 001 Nr. 3009: any cipher passage without a contemporary decipherment (the archive says 'mostly' deciphered; extent unknown)

outcome.notes: Not attempted on the ciphertext: neither file is digitised. 27 Nov 2026: per the archive's reply (issue #1026, not seen here) both files carry contemporary decipherments, Nr. 673 in the margin and Nr. 3009 mostly above the lines; reproductions declined. Open: any unglossed passage of Nr. 3009 (needs physical access); sibling Nr. 7801 not covered; Hüttenheim 1974 not seen.
